label: Observation timestamp (UTC)
notes: All wearable observations are stamped in UTC. Local time is derivable using subject's known timezone (Slovenia: CET/CEST). H10 session HR rows are at 1-second cadence; watch rows are hourly (heart_rate) or daily/nightly summaries.

label: Subject pseudonym
notes: Join key. Watch coverage 15/20 — 5 subjects (MFU-0001, MFU-0004, MFU-0007, MFU-0008, MFU-0019) absent. H10 chest-strap coverage 6/10 Group 1 elderly (MFU-0003, MFU-0005, MFU-0009, MFU-0011, MFU-0013, MFU-0015); Group 2 relatives never receive H10 because no serious-games sessions are organised for them.

label: Device identifier
units_or_choices: POL-XXXXXXXX (Pacer Pro serial, subject-specific) or POL-H10A / POL-H10B (shared lab H10 strap)
notes: Watch IDs are deterministic per subject (same device worn across the 7-day window). H10 strap IDs are shared lab equipment — multiple subjects' session data will reference the same H10 device_id.

label: Data source / device model
notes: polar_pacer / polar_pacer_pro = watch worn continuously over the 7-day monitoring window, data ingested via the Polar AccessLink cloud sync (see ../Koda/Polar_data_acess_API). Both models surface the same AccessLink endpoints — Pacer Pro's HRV (rmssd) is more reliable, the base Pacer's rmssd may be missing in production, but both source values are emitted here. polar_h10 = chest strap worn during organised serious-games activity sessions in the lab, data captured via direct BLE. Partner ETL should treat polar_pacer and polar_pacer_pro equivalently for downstream analytics.

label: What is being measured
units_or_choices: heart_rate | heart_rate_resting | rr_interval | step_count | active_minutes | calories | distance | daily_activity_index | sleep_total | sleep_deep | sleep_light | sleep_rem | sleep_awake | sleep_score | rmssd | breathing_rate | ans_charge | cardio_load | cardio_load_ratio
notes: Drives interpretation of value/unit. Watch quantity_kinds derive from the AccessLink endpoints: activities (step_count, active_minutes, calories, distance, daily_activity_index), continuous-heart-rate (heart_rate hourly average, heart_rate_resting daily), sleep (sleep_total/deep/light/rem/awake/score), cardio-load (cardio_load, cardio_load_ratio), nightly-recharge (rmssd overnight HRV, breathing_rate, ans_charge). H10 quantity_kinds are heart_rate (per-second) and rr_interval (per-beat).

label: Observed value
units_or_choices: Type and range depend on quantity_kind
notes: Integer for counts, minutes, kcal, bpm, m; float for rr_interval, breathing_rate, cardio_load_ratio, daily_activity_index. Polar's no-paired-device sentinel for cardio-load is -1; not used in this example.

label: Unit of measurement
units_or_choices: bpm | count | minutes | kcal | m | ms | breaths_per_minute | dimensionless
notes: Aligns to quantity_kind. dimensionless covers Polar's headline scores (sleep_score 0-100, ans_charge 0-100, cardio_load arbitrary, cardio_load_ratio acute/chronic, daily_activity_index 0-1).
